visual_observations: Reviewed 12 peak-motion/final-stationary views and 6 skirt-hidden safety-shorts views in two technical contact sheets.
Walking produces localized hem lift; jogging lifts the leading panel more strongly, without whole-skirt inversion in reviewed frames.
Final stationary front and side views return to the standing skirt silhouette; slight local ripples remain.
Opaque connected black safety shorts cover the crotch in the reviewed wide crouch, diagonal crouch and right lunge views.
limitations: No gameplay animations or runtime video captured; agent did not launch, control or stop the game.
Offline recovery is not a runtime guarantee. Some deep-action clipping remains.
Blender does not emulate native PBZ shading, wind, animation transitions, LOD or teleport behavior.
